description: Behavioral eval scenarios for the DataInk skills. Each case is a prompt to run with the named skill and a checklist to score the output against. 'must' items are required for a pass; 'must_not' items fail the case if present. See README.md for how to run and score.

cases.prompt: Here are 12 product categories with annual revenue. Category 'Accessories' is the one leadership cares about. Make a chart: Electronics 4.2M, Furniture 3.1M, Accessories 2.9M, Office 2.6M, Apparel 2.2M, Outdoor 1.9M, Toys 1.6M, Beauty 1.4M, Grocery 1.1M, Auto 0.9M, Books 0.7M, Music 0.4M.
must: sorted bar chart (descending), horizontal orientation or readable labels
zero baseline on the value axis
Accessories highlighted; all other bars muted grey (highlight-one-grey-rest)
action title stating an insight, not 'Revenue by Category'
no legend; direct labels or axis labels only
ran check_contrast.py (or check_palette.py) on the chosen colors before finishing
must_not: more than ~10% of the surface highlighted

cases.prompt: Build a reference table of quarterly financials per region (revenue, cost, margin %, headcount) for the appendix of a board report. Readers will look up exact values.
must: confirms a table is the right medium (exact-value lookup)
regions in rows, measures in columns, meaningful sort order
numbers right-aligned with consistent precision; units/%/currency in headers, not cells
white space or light rules for grouping; no full grid or heavy borders
HTML output (if produced) uses <th scope> and a <caption>
must_not: recommending this table for a live presentation slide

cases.prompt: Review this chart: a pie chart with 12 slices showing market share per competitor, colored red for declining and green for growing companies, titled 'Market Share'. It will be published on our public web dashboard.
must: P0: chart-task mismatch flagged (12-slice pie), with sorted bar suggested
P0: color-only red/green encoding flagged, redundant encoding suggested
P0: missing alt text flagged for the web context
P1: generic title flagged, action title suggested
report ordered P0 then P1 then P2, each issue with a concrete fix
must_not: verdicts on exact contrast ratios without running check_contrast.py or sampling colors
cosmetic P2 advice presented as blocking

cases.prompt: Design an executive dashboard for a SaaS business: MRR, churn, NPS, CAC, LTV, support tickets, uptime, active users, trial conversions, and 6 more operational metrics the team wants included.
must: pushes back on including all 15 metrics; selects 1-3 primary KPIs
primary KPIs top-left/top-row, large; supporting charts below; detail last
bullet graphs or KPI tiles with sparklines (with min/max/target context)
single-screen layout, or explicit drill-down/secondary views for the rest
applies the 5-second test before finishing
must_not: more than one vivid color outside alert states

cases.prompt: Our churn doubled after the pricing change, but revenue per account is up 20%. Help me structure a 10-minute presentation asking the exec team to approve a win-back campaign budget.
must: captures context first (audience, medium, goal, time) and states a one-sentence Big Idea
three-act arc: setup, tension between what-is and what-could-be, resolution
explicit, specific call to action (approve X by Y)
action titles for every slide; horizontal-logic check reading titles in sequence
leads with the ending for a time-constrained exec audience (or justifies chronological)
must_not: starting with chart selection before the narrative is structured

cases.prompt: Create a one-page public infographic from our annual impact report: 40% emissions cut since 2020, 12k trees planted, 3 new community programs, 98% employee participation.
must: storyboard with beginning/middle/end before layout; 3-minute story articulated
simple large text for the headline numbers; accurate encodings for any bars/lines
one insight per panel with a focal point; 10% highlighting rule respected
contrast verified with the scripts; alt text drafted per panel
eyes-drawn test applied to each panel and the whole
must_not: 3D or distorted encodings even for memorability
a disjointed grid of facts with no narrative order
color as the only encoding of meaning
